periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Prominently oval, with a vertical height approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering below the geometric center, extending toward the lower cheek area.
